title: 矽中介層佈線
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入矽中介層布線、TSV 與回流路徑。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore silicon interposer routing, tsvs and return paths, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 接口與架構
stages.description: 針對接口與架構完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for interfaces and architecture, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 被動與主動中介層｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Passive and active interposers | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對被動與主動中介層，把「是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For passive and active interposers, turn "Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「被動與主動中介層」的模型：是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for passive and active interposers: Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Mark passive wiring and active functions. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Mark passive wiring and active functions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有矽中介層都只是無源連線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating all silicon interposers as passive. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付被動與主動中介層的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for passive and active interposers, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 被動與主動中介層：機制
knowledge.text: 是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。
knowledge.textEn: Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。 必須排除的錯判：所有矽中介層都只是無源連線。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Mark passive wiring and active functions. Misinterpretation to reject: Treating all silicon interposers as passive. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「矽中介層佈線」的「被動與主動中介層｜機制與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「接合線：失蹤的良率」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Passive and active interposers | mechanism and design” in “Silicon-interposer routing”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 在「被動與主動中介層」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For passive and active interposers — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。
所有矽中介層都只是無源連線
線長相同即傳輸行為相同
optionsEn: Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements.
Treating all silicon interposers as passive
quiz.explanation: 是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。 標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。 因此不能採用「所有矽中介層都只是無源連線」。
quiz.explanationEn: Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements. Mark passive wiring and active functions. Therefore reject: Treating all silicon interposers as passive.

steps.title: 被動與主動中介層｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Passive and active interposers | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對被動與主動中介層，把「是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For passive and active interposers, turn "Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。 將「所有矽中介層都只是無源連線」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Mark passive wiring and active functions. Challenge the hypothesis "Treating all silicon interposers as passive" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Mark passive wiring and active functions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有矽中介層都只是無源連線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating all silicon interposers as passive. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付被動與主動中介層的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for passive and active interposers: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 晶粒邊界分配｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Die shoreline allocation | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對晶粒邊界分配，把「I/O 位置須同回流、電源與冗餘共享邊界。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For die shoreline allocation, turn "I/O shares shoreline with returns, power and redundancy." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「晶粒邊界分配」的模型：I/O 位置須同回流、電源與冗餘共享邊界。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「按實際節距計算可用連接數。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for die shoreline allocation: I/O shares shoreline with returns, power and redundancy. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Count usable connections at actual pitch. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 按實際節距計算可用連接數。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Count usable connections at actual pitch. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：幾何位置數等於全部可用訊號數。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating geometric positions with signal count. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付晶粒邊界分配的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for die shoreline allocation, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

I/O 位置須同回流、電源與冗餘共享邊界。

I/O shares shoreline with returns, power and redundancy.

steps.observationEn: Draw dielectric thickness and returns by layer. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：增加金屬層總能無代價解決布線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming extra metal layers solve routing without cost. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付層疊規劃的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for stackup planning: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 層疊規劃：機制
knowledge.text: 配線層與參考平面決定路由和阻抗。
knowledge.textEn: Routing layers and reference planes determine routes/impedance.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 畫每層介電厚度及回流。 必須排除的錯判：增加金屬層總能無代價解決布線。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Draw dielectric thickness and returns by layer. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming extra metal layers solve routing without cost. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「層疊規劃」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For stackup planning — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 增加金屬層總能無代價解決布線
矽中介層可視為完全絕緣背景
畫每層介電厚度及回流。
optionsEn: Assuming extra metal layers solve routing without cost
Treating silicon as a perfect insulator
Draw dielectric thickness and returns by layer.
quiz.explanation: 配線層與參考平面決定路由和阻抗。 畫每層介電厚度及回流。 因此不能採用「增加金屬層總能無代價解決布線」。
quiz.explanationEn: Routing layers and reference planes determine routes/impedance. Draw dielectric thickness and returns by layer. Therefore reject: Assuming extra metal layers solve routing without cost.
